_note: What enemies say and the noises creatures make in a fight (world/combat/combat_barks.gd). voices: a kind of talking enemy, the monsters that speak with it and its lines for each moment (battle: when it first acts; strike: when its attack lands; hurt: a heavy blow on it; death: as it falls); each kind speaks as the speaker bark_<kind> (audio/voice/casting.json). noises: a kind of creature that doesn't talk, its monsters and, for each moment, sound-effect prompts with their length in seconds, made as the speaker noise_<kind>. Both are generated by make voice (ADR 0013) and keyed by the text, so an edited line or prompt makes a new clip.

battle: Your purse or your throat, stranger.
Nobody leaves these woods with full pockets.
Take them! Quick, before the wolves do!
strike: That's for wandering off the road!
death: Should have... stayed in the village...

battle: Surround them. Leave none standing.
You picked the wrong road, outlanders.
Steel out, lads! We eat tonight!
strike: Kneel, and I might let you crawl away.
Is that all the steel you've got?
hurt: Lucky strike. You won't get another.

battle: In the Baron's name, lay down your arms!
Troublemakers. Take them!
Halt! You'll answer for this!
Blood! Give me blood!
Come on, then! Come ON!
I'll break you open!
The dark is hungry, and you will feed it.
Blood for the master!
Kneel to the night!
strike: He sees you. He sees all of you.

battle: Fresh meat for the cauldron!
Oh, look at the pretty heroes. Hee hee!
Come closer, dearies.
strike: Hee hee hee! Dance for me!
Your bones will make a fine broth.

battle: The hill hungers, and you are its harvest.
The Wicker will burn you, outlanders!
Roots, rise! Bind them!
strike: The land takes back its own.
hurt: The Mother will not forgive this!

battle: Visitors! Master wants visitors!
Not supposed to be here! Not supposed!
Hehh. Hehh. Fresh ones!
I can hear your heart racing.
Such warm, sweet blood.
The master said I could keep you.
Sweet dreams have a price, little ones.
I'll keep your souls in a jar.
Come, come. Auntie's waiting.
death: Not the end... never the end...

battle: Out of my way. I came back for one thing only.
I clawed my way from the grave. You won't stop me.
Vengeance does not sleep.
hurt: Pain means nothing to me now.

battle: The living, here? How foolish.
Your warmth will be mine.
Rise, my dead. We have guests.
hurt: You cannot kill what is dead!

battle: Ogre hungry!
Little people! Squish!
You... food!
The pack hunts tonight!
I smell your fear from here.
Run. I like it when they run.
For the Order of the Silver Dragon!
You trespass upon sacred ground!
Stand and be judged!
How tedious. Very well, let us negotiate in blood.
Your souls are worth more than you know.
I have read how this ends. You lose.
strike: A bargain you should not have refused.
death: I shall... return to the Lower Planes...
